description: Test fixture standing in for a judge registry (spec/court-record-key.md section 10.2) for the examples in examples/cap only. It is not a judge registry. It holds the judges who author a part of an example, each registered for the court code that example uses. printed lists printed forms of a judge's name (spec section 10.2): the name as CAP prints it in an opinion's byline, the text before the byline's first comma, with the CAP case it was seen in. examples/cap/build.py links a byline to a slug only when that text equals an entry's name or one of its printed forms exactly.
